answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 47 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 17 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 47 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 370 sponsors, each risking real money. The ledge of the design is public, the knoll of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the reef of honest work is what finally pays.
